```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)
library(plotly)

schools  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
surveys  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "surveys.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Parse dates (mixed formats)
surveys <- surveys |>
  mutate(
    survey_date = coalesce(mdy_hms(StartDate), ymd_hms(StartDate)),
    survey_year = year(survey_date)
  )

# Fix has_library: count any "Yes..." variant as Yes
surveys <- surveys |>
  mutate(
    has_library_yn = case_when(
      str_starts(has_library, "Yes") ~ "Yes",
      has_library == "No"            ~ "No",
      TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Join school-level program flags onto survey data
surveys <- surveys |>
  left_join(
    schools |> select(school_name, MGR, Library, `Feminine Hygiene Kits`, Computer, `Science Kits`),
    by = "school_name"
  )

available_years <- sort(unique(surveys$survey_year[!is.na(surveys$survey_year)]))

# Date range defaults: current school year (Aug 1 – Jul 31)
survey_dates <- as.Date(surveys$survey_date[!is.na(surveys$survey_date)])
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
survey_date_min <- school_year_start
survey_date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())
n_responses <- nrow(surveys)
n_schools   <- n_distinct(surveys$school_name, na.rm = TRUE)
n_total_schools <- nrow(schools)

# ── JSON data for interactive Key Insights charts ──────────────────────
survey_data <- surveys |>
  transmute(
    school_name,
    survey_date = as.character(as.Date(survey_date)),
    lantern_group,
    has_library_yn,
    menstrual_kit,
    has_computers,
    Q3,
    Q6, Q7, Q8, Q9,
    Q13, Q14, Q15, Q16,
    Q24, Q25, Q26, Q28,
    Q32, Q33, Q34,
    Q37, Q38, Q39, Q41,
    MGR           = as.character(MGR),
    Library       = as.character(Library),
    fem_hygiene   = as.character(`Feminine Hygiene Kits`),
    Computer      = as.character(Computer),
    science_kits  = as.character(`Science Kits`)
  )

survey_json      <- toJSON(survey_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
school_names_sorted <- sort(unique(surveys$school_name[!is.na(surveys$school_name)]))
school_names_json <- toJSON(school_names_sorted)

# ── HTML helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
school_opts <- paste0(
  '<option value="', school_names_sorted, '">', school_names_sorted, '</option>',
  collapse = "\n"
)

chart_box <- function(title, id, type = "bar", height = 250, subtitle = NULL) {
  sub_html <- ""
  if (!is.null(subtitle)) {
    sub_html <- sprintf('<p style="margin:0 0 0.5rem; color:#666; font-size:0.8rem;">%s</p>', subtitle)
  }
  if (type == "pie") {
    sprintf(
      '<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);">
        <h4 style="margin-top:0; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.95rem;">%s</h4>%s
        <canvas id="%s"></canvas>
        <p id="n-%s" style="text-align:center; color:#999; font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:0;"></p>
      </div>', title, sub_html, id, id)
  } else {
    sprintf(
      '<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);">
        <h4 style="margin-top:0; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.95rem;">%s</h4>%s
        <div style="height:%dpx;"><canvas id="%s"></canvas></div>
        <p id="n-%s" style="text-align:center; color:#999; font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:0;"></p>
      </div>', title, sub_html, height, id, id)
  }
}

tab_btn <- function(label, tab, active = FALSE) {
  bg <- if (active) "#1C2B4A" else "#e9ecef"
  fg <- if (active) "#fff" else "#333"
  sprintf(
    '<button class="ki-tab" data-tab="%s" onclick="showInsightsTab(\'%s\')" style="padding:0.5rem 1.2rem; border:none; border-radius:4px 4px 0 0; background:%s; color:%s; font-weight:600; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer;">%s</button>',
    tab, tab, bg, fg, label)
}

# ── Build tab HTML ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grid_open  <- '<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap:1.5rem;">'
grid_close <- '</div>'

lanterns_tab <- paste0(
  '<div id="tab-lanterns" class="ki-panel" style="display:block;">',
  grid_open,
  chart_box("Students Currently in a Lantern Group", "lantern-group", "pie", subtitle = "Percentage of students in MGR schools who report being part of a lantern group this term"),
  chart_box("Teacher Checks In With Lantern Groups", "teacher-checkin", "pie"),
  chart_box("Frequency of Lantern Group Meetings", "meeting-freq", "bar", 220, subtitle = "How often students report meeting with their group per week"),
  chart_box("Experience as a Lantern Leader", "leader-exp", "bar", 200, subtitle = "How current lantern leaders describe their leadership role"),
  chart_box("Challenges With Lanterns", "lantern-challenges", "bar", 220, subtitle = "Most frequent problems students experience with the lanterns"),

  chart_box("When Students Visit the Library", "library-when", "bar", 200, subtitle = "How students typically access the library"),

menstrual_tab <- paste0(

  chart_box("How Often Girls Use Their Kits", "kit-usage", "pie", subtitle = "Reported frequency of use among girls who have received a kit"),
  chart_box("Benefits Experienced", "kit-benefits", "bar", 250, subtitle = "Count of the most common positive impacts girls experience from the kits"),
  chart_box("Challenges Experienced", "kit-challenges", "bar", 280, subtitle = "Count of the most common difficulties girls report with the kits"),

computers_tab <- paste0(
  '<div id="tab-computers" class="ki-panel" style="display:none;">',
  grid_open,
  chart_box("How Often Computers are Used Each Week", "computer-freq", "bar", 250),
  chart_box("Activities Computers are Used For", "computer-activities", "bar", 280),
  chart_box("Computer Use Outside of Class", "computer-outside", "pie"),
  chart_box("Subjects Computers Are Used For", "computer-subjects", "bar", 280),

science_tab <- paste0(
  '<div id="tab-science" class="ki-panel" style="display:none;">',
  grid_open,
  chart_box("Science Kit Usage", "science-usage", "pie", subtitle = "Percentage of students who report having used a science kit during the current term"),
  chart_box("Science Kit Use Frequency", "science-freq", "bar", 200, subtitle = "Distribution of how often students used the science kits the term"),
  chart_box("Challenges Using Science Kits", "science-challenges", "bar", 220, subtitle = "Number of students reporting difficulties they experienced with the science kits"),
  grid_close, '</div>')

# ── JavaScript code (raw string to avoid quoting issues) ──────────────
js_code <- r"--(
var charts = {};
var SURVEY_DATA, SCHOOL_NAMES;

// Populate school dropdown
(function() {
  var sel = document.getElementById("insights-school-filter");
  if (!sel) return;
  SCHOOL_NAMES.forEach(function(name) {
    var opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = name;
    opt.textContent = name;
    sel.appendChild(opt);
  });
})();

function filterBySchool(data, school) {
  if (!school) return data;
  return data.filter(function(d) { return d.school_name === school; });
}

function countSingle(data, field) {
  var counts = {};
  data.forEach(function(d) {
    var v = d[field];
    if (v && v !== "null" && v !== "") {
      counts[v] = (counts[v] || 0) + 1;
    }
  });
  return counts;
}

function countMulti(data, field) {
  var counts = {};
  data.forEach(function(d) {
    var v = d[field];
    if (v && v !== "null" && v !== "") {
      v.split(",").forEach(function(item) {
        item = item.trim();
        if (item.indexOf("Other") === 0) item = "Other";
        if (item) counts[item] = (counts[item] || 0) + 1;
      });
    }
  });
  return counts;
}

function sortedDesc(counts) {
  return Object.entries(counts).sort(function(a, b) { return b[1] - a[1]; });
}

function destroyChart(id) {
  if (charts[id]) { charts[id].destroy(); delete charts[id]; }
}

function truncLabel(label, max) {
  max = max || 40;
  return label.length > max ? label.substring(0, max - 3) + "..." : label;
}

var PIE_COLORS = ["#1C2B4A", "#F5B800", "#3498db", "#28a745", "#e67e22", "#9b59b6", "#dc3545", "#1abc9c", "#95a5a6"];

function makePie(id, labels, values, customColors) {
  destroyChart(id);
  var canvas = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!canvas) return;
  var total = values.reduce(function(a,b) { return a + b; }, 0);
  var colors = customColors || PIE_COLORS.slice(0, labels.length);
  charts[id] = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: "pie",
    data: {
      labels: labels,
      datasets: [{ data: values, backgroundColor: colors }]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: true,
      plugins: {
        legend: { position: "bottom", labels: { font: { size: 11 } } },
        tooltip: {
          callbacks: {
            label: function(ctx) {
              var pct = total > 0 ? Math.round(ctx.raw / total * 100) : 0;
              return ctx.label + ": " + ctx.raw + " (" + pct + "%" + ")";
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

function makeHBar(id, labels, values, color, xlabel) {
  destroyChart(id);
  var canvas = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!canvas) return;
  var total = values.reduce(function(a,b) { return a + b; }, 0);
  charts[id] = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: "bar",
    data: {
      labels: labels.map(function(l) { return truncLabel(l); }),
      datasets: [{ data: values, backgroundColor: color || "#1C2B4A" }]
    },
    options: {
      indexAxis: "y",
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: false },
        tooltip: {
          callbacks: {
            label: function(ctx) {
              var pct = total > 0 ? Math.round(ctx.raw / total * 100) : 0;
              return ctx.raw + " responses (" + pct + "%" + ")";
            }
          }
        }
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          title: { display: !!xlabel, text: xlabel || "" },
          beginAtZero: true
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

function setN(id, n) {
  var el = document.getElementById("n-" + id);
  if (el) el.textContent = n > 0 ? "n = " + n : "No responses";
}

function showInsightsTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".ki-panel").forEach(function(p) { p.style.display = "none"; });
  document.querySelectorAll(".ki-tab").forEach(function(b) {
    b.style.background = "#e9ecef";
    b.style.color = "#333";
  });
  var panel = document.getElementById("tab-" + tab);
  if (panel) panel.style.display = "block";
  var btn = document.querySelector('.ki-tab[data-tab="' + tab + '"]');
  if (btn) { btn.style.background = "#1C2B4A"; btn.style.color = "#fff"; }
}

/* ── Participation chart ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderParticipation(data) {
  var programs = [
    { name: "Lanterns", compute: function(d) {
        var el = d.filter(function(r) { return r.MGR === "1" && r.lantern_group && r.lantern_group !== "null"; });
        var us = el.filter(function(r) { return r.lantern_group === "Yes"; });
        return el.length > 0 ? Math.round(us.length / el.length * 100) : 0;
    }},
    { name: "Library", compute: function(d) {
        var el = d.filter(function(r) { return r.Library === "1" && r.has_library_yn && r.has_library_yn !== "null"; });
        var us = el.filter(function(r) { return r.has_library_yn === "Yes"; });
        return el.length > 0 ? Math.round(us.length / el.length * 100) : 0;
    }},
    { name: "Menstrual Kits", compute: function(d) {
        // Eligible: girls who received a kit and answered the usage question
        var el = d.filter(function(r) { return r.fem_hygiene === "1" && r.menstrual_kit && r.menstrual_kit !== "null" && r.menstrual_kit !== "No"; });
        // Using: anyone whose Q32 answer is NOT a "never" or "do not have a kit" variant
        var us = el.filter(function(r) {
          if (!r.Q32 || r.Q32 === "null") return false;
          var q = r.Q32.toLowerCase();
          return q.indexOf("never") < 0 && q.indexOf("do not have") < 0;
        });
        return el.length > 0 ? Math.round(us.length / el.length * 100) : 0;
    }},
    { name: "Computers", compute: function(d) {
        var el = d.filter(function(r) { return r.Computer === "1" && r.has_computers && r.has_computers !== "null"; });
        var us = el.filter(function(r) { return r.has_computers === "Yes"; });
        return el.length > 0 ? Math.round(us.length / el.length * 100) : 0;
    }},
    { name: "Science Kits", compute: function(d) {
        var el = d.filter(function(r) { return r.science_kits === "1" && (r.Q6 === "Yes" || r.Q6 === "No"); });
        var us = el.filter(function(r) { return r.Q6 === "Yes"; });
        return el.length > 0 ? Math.round(us.length / el.length * 100) : 0;
    }}
  ];

  var results = programs.map(function(p) { return { name: p.name, pct: p.compute(data) }; });
  results.sort(function(a, b) { return a.pct - b.pct; });

  destroyChart("chart-participation");
  var canvas = document.getElementById("chart-participation");
  if (!canvas) return;
  charts["chart-participation"] = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: "bar",
    data: {
      labels: results.map(function(r) { return r.name; }),
      datasets: [{ data: results.map(function(r) { return r.pct; }), backgroundColor: "#F5B800" }]
    },
    options: {
      indexAxis: "y",
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: false },
        tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return ctx.raw + "%"; } } }
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          title: { display: true, text: "% Participation Among Eligible" },
          beginAtZero: true,
          max: 100,
          ticks: { callback: function(v) { return v + "%"; } }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

/* ── Lanterns & MGR ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderLanterns(data) {
  var mgrData = data.filter(function(d) { return d.MGR === "1"; });

  // In Lantern Group pie — relabel Yes/No
  var groupData = mgrData.filter(function(d) { return d.lantern_group && d.lantern_group !== "null"; });
  var gc = countSingle(groupData, "lantern_group");
  // Force order: In a group first (matches yellow on left), Not in a group second
  var e = [["In a group", gc["Yes"] || 0], ["Not in a group", gc["No"] || 0]];
  if (e.length > 0) makePie("lantern-group", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), ["#F5B800", "#1C2B4A"]);
  setN("lantern-group", groupData.length);

  // Teacher Check-ins (lantern members only) — group into Yes/No
  var members = mgrData.filter(function(d) { return d.lantern_group === "Yes" && d.Q26 && d.Q26 !== "null"; });
  var tc = countSingle(members, "Q26");
  var tcGrouped = { "Yes": 0, "No": 0 };
  Object.keys(tc).forEach(function(k) {
    if (k.toLowerCase().indexOf("yes") === 0) tcGrouped["Yes"] += tc[k];
    else tcGrouped["No"] += tc[k];
  });
  e = sortedDesc(tcGrouped);
  if (e.length > 0) {
    var tcLabels = e.map(function(x){return x[0];});
    var tcValues = e.map(function(x){return x[1];});
    var tcColors = tcLabels.map(function(l) { return l === "Yes" ? "#F5B800" : "#1C2B4A"; });
    makePie("teacher-checkin", tcLabels, tcValues, tcColors);
  }
  setN("teacher-checkin", members.length);

  // Meeting Frequency — group into buckets, ordered bottom-to-top: 1-2x, 3-4x, 5-6x, Daily
  var freqD = mgrData.filter(function(d) { return d.lantern_group === "Yes" && d.Q25 && d.Q25 !== "null"; });
  var rawFreq = countSingle(freqD, "Q25");
  var freqBuckets = { "1-2x": 0, "3-4x": 0, "5-6x": 0, "Daily": 0 };
  Object.keys(rawFreq).forEach(function(k) {
    if (k === "Every day") freqBuckets["Daily"] += rawFreq[k];
    else if (k.indexOf("2") >= 0) freqBuckets["1-2x"] += rawFreq[k];
    else if (k.indexOf("3") >= 0 || k.indexOf("4") >= 0) freqBuckets["3-4x"] += rawFreq[k];
    else if (k.indexOf("5") >= 0 || k.indexOf("6") >= 0) freqBuckets["5-6x"] += rawFreq[k];
  });
  // Order: top-to-bottom = Daily, 5-6x, 3-4x, 1-2x (so bottom-to-top reads 1-2x → Daily)
  var freqLabels = ["Daily", "5-6x", "3-4x", "1-2x"];
  var freqValues = freqLabels.map(function(l) { return freqBuckets[l] || 0; });
  if (freqD.length > 0) makeHBar("meeting-freq", freqLabels, freqValues, "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("meeting-freq", freqD.length);

  // Leader Experience (multi-select, lantern members) — relabel
  var expD = mgrData.filter(function(d) { return d.lantern_group === "Yes" && d.Q24 && d.Q24 !== "null"; });
  var ec2 = countMulti(expD, "Q24");
  var expMap = {
    "Difficult": "Difficult", "Stressful": "Stressful",
    "Enjoys the responsibility": "Enjoys the responsibility"
  };
  // Map any long labels containing keywords
  var expMapped = {};
  Object.keys(ec2).forEach(function(k) {
    var kl = k.toLowerCase();
    if (kl.indexOf("difficult") >= 0) expMapped["Difficult"] = (expMapped["Difficult"] || 0) + ec2[k];
    else if (kl.indexOf("stressful") >= 0) expMapped["Stressful"] = (expMapped["Stressful"] || 0) + ec2[k];
    else if (kl.indexOf("enjoy") >= 0) expMapped["Enjoys the responsibility"] = (expMapped["Enjoys the responsibility"] || 0) + ec2[k];
    else expMapped[k] = (expMapped[k] || 0) + ec2[k];
  });
  e = sortedDesc(expMapped);
  if (e.length > 0) makeHBar("leader-exp", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("leader-exp", expD.length);

  // Challenges (multi-select, lantern members only) — remove No Problem/Other, combine group meeting issues
  var chalD = mgrData.filter(function(d) { return d.lantern_group === "Yes" && d.Q28 && d.Q28 !== "null"; });
  var cc = countMulti(chalD, "Q28");
  delete cc["No Problem"]; delete cc["No Problems"]; delete cc["No problems"]; delete cc["Other"]; delete cc["Other:"];
  // Combine group meeting issues
  var groupMeetingCount = 0;
  ["Group not meeting together", "Group not meeting often enough"].forEach(function(k) {
    if (cc[k]) { groupMeetingCount += cc[k]; delete cc[k]; }
  });
  if (groupMeetingCount > 0) cc["Group not meeting/not meeting often enough"] = groupMeetingCount;
  // Remove zero-count entries
  Object.keys(cc).forEach(function(k) { if (cc[k] === 0) delete cc[k]; });
  e = sortedDesc(cc);
  if (e.length > 0) makeHBar("lantern-challenges", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("lantern-challenges", chalD.length);
}

/* ── Libraries ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderLibraries(data) {
  var libData = data.filter(function(d) { return d.Library === "1"; });

  // Book Checkout (Q15) — remove "I do not know", relabel
  var coD = libData.filter(function(d) { return d.Q15 && d.Q15 !== "null" && d.Q15 !== "I do not know"; });
  var cc = countSingle(coD, "Q15");
  var coLabeled = { "Allowed to check out books": 0, "Not allowed to check out books": 0 };
  Object.keys(cc).forEach(function(k) {
    if (k === "Yes") coLabeled["Allowed to check out books"] += cc[k];
    else if (k === "No") coLabeled["Not allowed to check out books"] += cc[k];
  });
  var e = sortedDesc(coLabeled);
  if (e.length > 0) makePie("book-checkout", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}));
  setN("book-checkout", coD.length);

  // Visit Frequency (Q14) — relabel and factor order (bottom-to-top: Have never visited → More than 3x per week)
  var frD = libData.filter(function(d) { return d.Q14 && d.Q14 !== "null"; });
  var rawFC = countSingle(frD, "Q14");
  var freqMap = {
    "I have never visited": "Have never visited",
    "Less than once a week": "Less than 1x",
    "1-2 times a week": "1-2x",
    "More than 3 times a week": ">3x"
  };
  var freqLabels = [">3x", "1-2x", "Less than 1x", "Have never visited"];
  var freqValues = freqLabels.map(function(newLabel) {
    var count = 0;
    Object.keys(rawFC).forEach(function(k) { if (freqMap[k] === newLabel) count += rawFC[k]; });
    return count;
  });
  if (frD.length > 0) makeHBar("library-freq", freqLabels, freqValues, "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("library-freq", frD.length);

  // How Students Utilize Library (Q13) — group all responses into 3 categories
  var whD = libData.filter(function(d) { return d.Q13 && d.Q13 !== "null"; });
  var whc = countMulti(whD, "Q13");
  delete whc["Never"];
  var whenBuckets = { "Visit on their own": 0, "Visit with their class": 0, "Teachers bring back books": 0 };
  Object.keys(whc).forEach(function(k) {
    var kl = k.toLowerCase();
    if (kl.indexOf("on my own") >= 0 || kl.indexOf("on their own") >= 0 || kl.indexOf("own") >= 0) {
      whenBuckets["Visit on their own"] += whc[k];
    } else if (kl.indexOf("class") >= 0) {
      whenBuckets["Visit with their class"] += whc[k];
    } else if (kl.indexOf("teacher") >= 0 || kl.indexOf("brings") >= 0) {
      whenBuckets["Teachers bring back books"] += whc[k];
    }
  });
  var whenPairs = Object.entries(whenBuckets).filter(function(p) { return p[1] > 0; });
  whenPairs.sort(function(a,b) { return b[1] - a[1]; });
  if (whenPairs.length > 0) makeHBar("library-when", whenPairs.map(function(p){return p[0];}), whenPairs.map(function(p){return p[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("library-when", whD.length);
}

/* ── Menstrual Kits ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderMenstrualKits(data) {
  var mkData = data.filter(function(d) { return d.fem_hygiene === "1"; });

  // Received Kit pie (menstrual_kit) — relabel to Have received / Have not received
  var rkD = mkData.filter(function(d) { return d.menstrual_kit && d.menstrual_kit !== "null"; });
  var rkc = countSingle(rkD, "menstrual_kit");
  var rkGrouped = { "Have received": 0, "Have not received": 0 };
  Object.keys(rkc).forEach(function(k) {
    if (k.toLowerCase().indexOf("yes") === 0) rkGrouped["Have received"] += rkc[k];
    else if (k === "No") rkGrouped["Have not received"] += rkc[k];
  });
  var e = sortedDesc(rkGrouped);
  if (e.length > 0) makePie("received-kit", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}));
  setN("received-kit", rkD.length);

  // Usage Frequency pie (Q32, kit recipients only) — grouped into Always / Sometimes / Never
  var usD = mkData.filter(function(d) { return d.menstrual_kit === "Yes" && d.Q32 && d.Q32 !== "null" && d.Q32.indexOf("I do not have a kit") < 0; });
  var usGrouped = { "Always": 0, "Sometimes": 0, "Never": 0 };
  usD.forEach(function(d) {
    var q = d.Q32.toLowerCase();
    if (q === "always" || q.indexOf("every time i have my period") >= 0) {
      usGrouped["Always"]++;
    } else if (q === "sometimes" || q.indexOf("every other month") >= 0) {
      usGrouped["Sometimes"]++;
    } else if (q.indexOf("never") >= 0) {
      usGrouped["Never"]++;
    }
  });
  Object.keys(usGrouped).forEach(function(k) { if (usGrouped[k] === 0) delete usGrouped[k]; });
  e = sortedDesc(usGrouped);
  if (e.length > 0) makePie("kit-usage", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}));
  setN("kit-usage", usD.length);

  // Reported Benefits (Q33, multi-select, kit recipients) — remove "I do not have a kit", "The kit has not helped me", "Other"; combine similar
  var benefitMap = {
    "I have learned more about my body and cycle": "Learned about body",
    "The training helped me learn more about my body": "Learned about body",
    "I no longer miss school because of my period": "No longer miss school",
    "I feel more confident and comfortable when I have my period": "Gained more confidence",
    "The training has helped me to calculate my period so I get prepared and do not spoil my dress": "Gained more confidence"
  };
  var beD = mkData.filter(function(d) { return d.menstrual_kit === "Yes" && d.Q33 && d.Q33 !== "null"; });
  var bec = countMulti(beD, "Q33");
  delete bec["Other"]; delete bec["Other:"]; delete bec["I do not have a kit"]; delete bec["The kit has not helped me"];
  var benMapped = {};
  Object.keys(bec).forEach(function(k) { var lbl = benefitMap[k] || k; benMapped[lbl] = (benMapped[lbl] || 0) + bec[k]; });
  Object.keys(benMapped).forEach(function(k) { if (benMapped[k] === 0) delete benMapped[k]; });
  e = sortedDesc(benMapped);
  if (e.length > 0) makeHBar("kit-benefits", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("kit-benefits", beD.length);

  // Reported Challenges (Q34, multi-select, kit recipients) — combine similar, remove "I do not have a kit", "Other"
  var challengeMap = {
    "I have no challenges with the kit": "No challenges",
    "Not enough underwear to use during my period": "Not enough underwear",
    "The pads and underwear are difficult to clean": "Difficult to clean",
    "The reusable pads feel uncomfortable": "Uncomfortable pads",
    "The pads feel puffy or uncomfortable": "Uncomfortable pads",
    "Not enough reusable pads to use during my period": "Not enough pads",
    "Not enough pads to use during my period": "Not enough pads",
    "I am embarrassed to wash them": "Embarrassed to wash",
    "The reusable pads feel bulky": "Uncomfortable pads",
    "The pads leak": "Pads leak",
    "Other students make fun of me when they notice me carrying my case at school": "Teased by other students"
  };
  var chD = mkData.filter(function(d) { return d.menstrual_kit === "Yes" && d.Q34 && d.Q34 !== "null"; });
  var chc = countMulti(chD, "Q34");
  delete chc["Other"]; delete chc["Other:"]; delete chc["I do not have a kit"];
  var chalMapped = {};
  Object.keys(chc).forEach(function(k) { var lbl = challengeMap[k] || k; chalMapped[lbl] = (chalMapped[lbl] || 0) + chc[k]; });
  Object.keys(chalMapped).forEach(function(k) { if (chalMapped[k] === 0) delete chalMapped[k]; });
  e = sortedDesc(chalMapped);
  if (e.length > 0) makeHBar("kit-challenges", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("kit-challenges", chD.length);
}

/* ── Computers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderComputers(data) {
  var compData = data.filter(function(d) { return d.Computer === "1"; });

  // How Often Computers are Used Each Week (Q37) — only students who have computers
  var frD = compData.filter(function(d) { return d.has_computers === "Yes" && d.Q37 && d.Q37 !== "null"; });
  var rawFrc = countSingle(frD, "Q37");
  var compFreqMap = {
    "Never": "Never", "1 time a week": "1x", "2 times a week": "2x",
    "3 times a week": "3x", "4 times a week": "4x", "Everyday": "Daily"
  };
  var compFreqBuckets = {};
  Object.keys(rawFrc).forEach(function(k) { var lbl = compFreqMap[k] || k; compFreqBuckets[lbl] = (compFreqBuckets[lbl] || 0) + rawFrc[k]; });
  var compFreqLabels = ["Daily", "4x", "3x", "2x", "1x", "Never"];
  var compFreqValues = compFreqLabels.map(function(l) { return compFreqBuckets[l] || 0; });
  if (frD.length > 0) makeHBar("computer-freq", compFreqLabels, compFreqValues, "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("computer-freq", frD.length);

  // Activities Computers are Used For (Q41) — group/rename/remove
  var actMap = {
    "Read a book": "Reading", "Read an article/web page": "Reading",
    "Watched a video": "Pictures/Videos", "Looked at pictures": "Pictures/Videos",
    "Used Excel/Word/other installed programs": "Word/Excel",
    "Played a game": "Games",
    "Gone on the RACHEL website": "RACHEL website"
  };
  var removeAct = { "Other": true, "Explored a website": true };
  var acD = compData.filter(function(d) { return d.has_computers === "Yes" && d.Q41 && d.Q41 !== "null"; });
  var rawAcc = countMulti(acD, "Q41");
  var actBuckets = {};
  Object.keys(rawAcc).forEach(function(k) {
    if (removeAct[k]) return;
    var lbl = actMap[k] || k;
    actBuckets[lbl] = (actBuckets[lbl] || 0) + rawAcc[k];
  });
  var e = sortedDesc(actBuckets);
  if (e.length > 0) makeHBar("computer-activities", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("computer-activities", acD.length);

  // Computer Use Outside of Class (Q39, pie) — only students who have computers
  var ouD = compData.filter(function(d) { return d.has_computers === "Yes" && d.Q39 && d.Q39 !== "null"; });
  var ouc = countSingle(ouD, "Q39");
  e = sortedDesc(ouc);
  if (e.length > 0) makePie("computer-outside", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}));
  setN("computer-outside", ouD.length);

  // Subjects Computers Are Used For (Q38) — only students who have computers, remove "Other"
  var suD = compData.filter(function(d) { return d.has_computers === "Yes" && d.Q38 && d.Q38 !== "null"; });
  var suc = countMulti(suD, "Q38");
  delete suc["Other"];
  e = sortedDesc(suc);
  if (e.length > 0) makeHBar("computer-subjects", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("computer-subjects", suD.length);
}

/* ── Science Kits ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderScienceKits(data) {
  var sciData = data.filter(function(d) { return d.science_kits === "1"; });

  // Usage pie (Q6) — relabel Yes/No
  var usD = sciData.filter(function(d) { return d.Q6 && d.Q6 !== "null"; });
  var usc = countSingle(usD, "Q6");
  var sciLabeled = { "Have used": usc["Yes"] || 0, "Have not used": usc["No"] || 0 };
  var e = sortedDesc(sciLabeled);
  if (e.length > 0) makePie("science-usage", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}));
  setN("science-usage", usD.length);

  // Frequency of Use Per Term (Q7) — factored order bottom-to-top: 1-2x, 3-4x, >5x
  var frD = sciData.filter(function(d) { return d.Q6 === "Yes" && d.Q7 && d.Q7 !== "null"; });
  var rawSciFreq = countSingle(frD, "Q7");
  var sciFreqMap = { "1-2 times": "1-2x", "3-4 times": "3-4x", "More than 5 times": ">5x" };
  var sciFreqBuckets = {};
  Object.keys(rawSciFreq).forEach(function(k) { var lbl = sciFreqMap[k] || k; sciFreqBuckets[lbl] = (sciFreqBuckets[lbl] || 0) + rawSciFreq[k]; });
  var sciFreqLabels = [">5x", "3-4x", "1-2x"];
  var sciFreqValues = sciFreqLabels.map(function(l) { return sciFreqBuckets[l] || 0; });
  if (frD.length > 0) makeHBar("science-freq", sciFreqLabels, sciFreqValues, "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("science-freq", frD.length);

  // Reported Challenges (Q9, multi-select) — only students who worked with kits, remove "Other" and "None"
  var chD = sciData.filter(function(d) { return d.Q6 === "Yes" && d.Q9 && d.Q9 !== "null"; });
  var chc = countMulti(chD, "Q9");
  delete chc["Other"]; delete chc["Other:"]; delete chc["None"]; delete chc["No problems"]; delete chc["No Problems"];
  // Merge "Teachers not allowing us to touch it ourselves" into "Not allowed to use with freedom"
  if (chc["Teachers not allowing us to touch it ourselves"]) {
    chc["Not allowed to use with freedom"] = (chc["Not allowed to use with freedom"] || 0) + chc["Teachers not allowing us to touch it ourselves"];
    delete chc["Teachers not allowing us to touch it ourselves"];
  }
  // Merge "Hard to understand" into "Difficult to understand"
  if (chc["Hard to understand"]) {
    chc["Difficult to understand"] = (chc["Difficult to understand"] || 0) + chc["Hard to understand"];
    delete chc["Hard to understand"];
  }
  e = sortedDesc(chc);
  if (e.length > 0) makeHBar("science-challenges", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}), "#1C2B4A", "Responses");
  setN("science-challenges", chD.length);
}

/* ── Demographics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderGender(data) {
  var genderD = data.filter(function(d) { return d.Q3 && d.Q3 !== "null" && d.Q3 !== ""; });
  var gc = countSingle(genderD, "Q3");
  var e = sortedDesc(gc);
  if (e.length > 0) makePie("chart-gender", e.map(function(x){return x[0];}), e.map(function(x){return x[1];}));
  setN("chart-gender", genderD.length);
}

function renderSchoolsRepresented(data) {
  var schoolSet = {};
  data.forEach(function(d) { if (d.school_name) schoolSet[d.school_name] = true; });
  var nSchools = Object.keys(schoolSet).length;
  var totalSchools = SCHOOL_NAMES.length;
  var pct = totalSchools > 0 ? Math.round(nSchools / totalSchools * 100) : 0;

  var fill = document.getElementById("schools-represented-fill");
  if (fill) {
    fill.style.width = Math.max(pct, 3) + "%";
    fill.textContent = pct + "% (" + nSchools + " of " + totalSchools + " schools)";
  }
  var label = document.getElementById("schools-represented-label");
  if (label) label.textContent = data.length + " responses from " + nSchools + " schools";
}

/* ── Master render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

function renderAll() {
  var school = document.getElementById("insights-school-filter").value;
  var startEl = document.getElementById("survey-date-start");
  var endEl = document.getElementById("survey-date-end");
  var start = startEl ? startEl.value : "";
  var end = endEl ? endEl.value : "";

  var data = SURVEY_DATA;
  if (start && end) {
    data = data.filter(function(d) { return inRange(d.survey_date, start, end); });
  }
  data = filterBySchool(data, school);

  // Update stat card
  var statEl = document.getElementById("stat-responses");
  if (statEl) statEl.textContent = data.length;

  renderGender(data);
  renderSchoolsRepresented(data);
  renderParticipation(data);
  renderLanterns(data);
  renderLibraries(data);
  renderMenstrualKits(data);
  renderComputers(data);
  renderScienceKits(data);
}

// Initial render + event listeners
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  renderAll();
  var applyBtn = document.getElementById("btn-survey-apply");
  if (applyBtn) applyBtn.addEventListener("click", renderAll);
  var resetBtn = document.getElementById("btn-survey-reset");
  if (resetBtn) resetBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
    var now = new Date();
    var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
    document.getElementById("survey-date-start").value = syYear + "-08-01";
    document.getElementById("survey-date-end").value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    renderAll();
  });
});
)--"

# ── Assemble the big HTML block ────────────────────────────────────────
insights_html <- paste0(
  # School filter
  '<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1.5rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">',
  '<label for="insights-school-filter" style="font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em;">Filter by School:</label>',
  '<select id="insights-school-filter" onchange="renderAll()" style="padding:0.4rem 0.8rem; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #ccc; font-size:1rem; min-width:200px;">',
  '<option value="">All Schools</option>',
  school_opts,
  '</select>',
  '</div>',

  # Participation chart
  '<h3>Overall Program Participation</h3>',
  '<p style="color:#666; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:1rem;"><em>Among students with access to each program, the percentage who report actively using it</em></p>',
  '<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:2rem;">',
  '<div style="height:280px;"><canvas id="chart-participation"></canvas></div>',
  '</div>',

  # Key Insights heading
  '<h3>Key Insights</h3>',
  '<p style="color:#666; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:1rem;"><em>Detailed breakdowns for each EPI program from student survey responses</em></p>',

  # Tab buttons
  '<div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:1.5rem;">',
  tab_btn("Lanterns & MGR", "lanterns", active = TRUE),
  tab_btn("Libraries", "libraries"),
  tab_btn("Menstrual Kits", "menstrual"),
  tab_btn("Computers", "computers"),
  tab_btn("Science Kits", "science"),
  '</div>',

  # Tab panels
  lanterns_tab,
  libraries_tab,
  menstrual_tab,
  computers_tab,
  science_tab,

  # Chart.js + data + render logic
  '<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>',
  '<script>',
  'var SURVEY_DATA = ', survey_json, ';\n',
  'var SCHOOL_NAMES = ', school_names_json, ';\n',
  js_code,
  '</script>'
)
```
